name: Crystalcore
summary: An aesthetic centered on crystals, gemstones, and mineral formations, emphasizing natural geometry, translucency, and prismatic light.
description: Crystalcore is an aesthetic that celebrates crystals, gemstones, and mineral formations. It emphasizes natural geometric structures, translucency, prismatic light refraction, and the raw beauty of geological formations. The aesthetic spans jewelry, interior design, digital art, and fashion, often incorporating amethyst, quartz, and other prized minerals. It overlaps with witchcore and celestial aesthetics.
